contests.title: Bartow County — increase county-tax homestead exemption

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved that provides for an amendment to the $15,000.00 homestead exemption from Bartow County ad valorem taxes for county purposes so as to increase the exemption to $30,000.00?

measures.questionText: Shall the Act be approved that provides for an amendment to the $15,000.00 homestead exemption from Bartow County ad valorem taxes for county purposes so as to increase the exemption to $30,000.00?

provenance.sourceOrg: Office of the Governor of Georgia
provenance.quote: Shall the Act be approved that provides for an amendment to the $15,000.00 homestead exemption from Bartow County ad valorem taxes for county purposes so as to increase the exemption to $30,000.00?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Raises the existing Bartow County homestead exemption from $15,000 to $30,000 of assessed home value for county property taxes. Assessed value above the exemption remains taxable. If voters approve, the increased exemption takes effect January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve increasing the county-tax homestead exemption to $30,000.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject the increase and retain the existing $15,000 exemption.
